summary: Full-stack engineer with a Python core — I take products from a blank repo to production. Around that I own the full stack — React/Vue front-ends, data modelling, auth and row-level security, Docker, CI/CD, and Playwright e2e tests from day one. Prior work spans fintech (NestJS, payments), a healthcare-professional marketplace, and a hyperlocal social app.
available: Available for new projects — and open to senior Python / full-stack roles. Fully remote, worldwide, or hybrid.
